document: The safety of ensuring our community are safe please do something, We need road safety measures in place by immediate effect

Review   UKG Petitions (UKGP) Committee Rules, UKGP rejects Petitions which do not fall within UKGP criteria. If another respectable  Petitions platform hosts a Petition which gains great popular support, in a very short space of time, it might be appropriate for the UKGP Committee to adopt that Petition so that it might properly be debated.

Make 'outing' someone's sexuality and/or gender identity a criminal offence., To make it illegal for people to 'out' someone for their sexual and/or gender identity without the persons' consent. Anyone who does this can be charged with committing a hate crime.

Stop work places having two tier sick pay for unvaccinated employees, If an unvaccinated individual is isolating due to catching COVID and a vaccinated individual has to isolate for the same reason they should receive the same sick pay and not be discriminated against over vaccination status.

Make sure the report into 'partygate' is published in full with the evidence, There are serious concerns that the report into staff gatherings in Government buildings will not be published in full. I want the public to be able to support this petition to show they believe in the need for total transparency.

Increase efforts to reclaim covid-19 payments lost to fraud, It has been widely reported that the Government expects not to reclaim £4.3 billion of Covid payments that were claimed fraudulently. We believe the Government should make every effort to recoup this money and ensure anyone who committed fraud is brought to justice.

Confirm a timeline for rollout of Veterans ID card to all veterans, The Government should set out a fixed timeline on when the veterans ID card will be made available to the wider community of veterans, and not just service leavers.

Make it law that any cyclist using the UK Public Highways has insurance, I want the government to make it law that any cyclist using the UK public highways has insurance to do so to fall in line with other road users.

Tax 50% of the Energy Companies profits to help households pay bills., The petition is to get MPs to debate that energy companies profits which are billions of pounds should be taxed at 50% from their profits to help UK households pay their energy bills.

Make reversing cameras mandatory on all HGVs., Alot of articulated lorries do not have reversing cameras fitted. It's impossible for a driver to see what is behind the vehicle especially on a blind side reverse. Resulting in many serious and fatal accidents.

Nationalise Energy Companies, The Government needs to take back ownership of strategic energy assets.  It needs to accept that the Free Market has failed the energy sector, that it is in the national interest to renationalise our energy assets.  The Government must therefore renationalise all the UK energy assets.

Create a nationwide regeneration plan run by an independent "Regeneration Tsar", To create a detailed plan for the repurposing & regeneration of every town and city in England, made available for full public consultation and supervised by an independent "Regeneration Tsar”. This should revisit the outcomes of the 'Future High Street Fund' and promote a nationwide solution.

Reinstate the former Highway Code rules of pedestrian right of way at junctions, The newest highway code changes which determine the way pedestrians assess road junctions and their right of way when crossing needs to be withdrawn and reconsidered with immediate effect with the help of motoring organisations to determine the best way of protecting all road users and pedestrians.

Open up Blackpool airport as a drag strip, A group of car enthusiasts would like the opportunity to create events at Blackpool airport. We think it is in the best interest to the public and Blackpool council that the airport can be used as a drag strip for drivers.

Get local councils to answer phones and respond to issues which website cannot., I would like the Government to get Local Councils to man phone lines like they used to pre covid. The website cannot handle certain queries. For complicated queries, we need to speak to someone in council departments. Councils must not use Covid as an excuse to avoid providing services.

Require the Royal Mail to continue to accept non-barcoded postage stamps, The Government should exercise its powers to issue directions to a universal service provider of postal services, to require the Royal Mail to continue to accept non-barcoded postage stamps after January 2023.

Abolish domestic COVID-status certification in the United Kingdom, We want the Government to abolish all domestic COVID-status certification remaining in use.

Due to high vaccination & booster uptake, continued relaxation of restrictions, and fast approaching endemicity of coronavirus, it is neither right nor proportionate to continue such measures in Britain.

Establish a safe route into the UK for Ukrainian refugees, As Russia invades Ukraine, thousands of Ukraine citizens are fleeing the country into the West. The US predicts some 5 million might be displaced due to the conflict. 

Some of them will be headed to the UK due to family links. We must be a safe haven in these times of war.

Redirect all foreign aid to Ukraine, The people of Ukraine are being invaded in a war that has no moral justification. Due to not being in NATO Ukraine is not receiving military support, so let's redirect all foreign aid to Ukraine to help them defend their country.

Prohibit the unsolicited delivery of plastic bags, The Government should prohibit the delivery of plastic bags, where these have not been requested. Many charities bulk mail plastic bags, for use to give donations, to households across the country. This contributes to harm against the environment, and can also be a risk to pets.

Require pharmaceutical companies to publish full data about clinical trials, The Government should require companies supplying pharmaceutical products like medicines and vaccines to the NHS to publish those products’ clinical trial results in full. Data must be available when trial results are announced, published, or used to justify regulatory decisions.
Free parking for NHS staff, Having had to work during the pandemic in unprecedented  pressures please for the loyalty to all the NHS staff make parking free In all hospitals for staff

Require Councils to publish all FOI responses online, FOI laws do not currently require local authorities to publish all FOI responses on their websites. This means potentially embarrassing or dangerous information is not shared with the wider public. Force local authorities to publish all FOI responses.

Amend the Equality Act so asexuality is an orientation, intersex as a sex., Section 11 of the Equality Act (2010), does not include intersex people which we believe it should.
Section 12 of the Equality Act (2010), does not include asexual people which we believe it should.

Make zero hour contracts illegal, The blanket phrase ‘zero hour contract’ allows many ways for companies to word ‘we can’t guarantee you any hours’ and in my opinion it is a really abused system! Hard-working employees should be allowed the guarantee of a set number of hours per week in return for the work they provide.

Make Prenatal Alienating a criminal offence in Scotland., There are to many fathers that are being denied appropriate access to children, and the mothers are aloud to brainwash the children into thinking fathers are bad perants, Scotland is so far behind the rest of the world on regards to this, its about time they caught up.
List long covid as a disability under the equality act 2010., Addition of long covid on the disability act.
Close all the bars at the Houses of Parliament., There is absolutely no need for bars in a workplace & definitely not when they are subsidised by taxpayers.
Allow rescue dogs from Romania, Belarus, Poland and Ukraine., Change the ban that is currently in place for “commercial” pets to not include rescue dogs.

Adopt plans for a common charging cable for all new electronic portable devices, The EU has provisionally agreed that all new portable electronic devices must, by autumn 2024, use a USB Type-C charger, regardless of who makes the devices.  However, the UK government has said that it is not adopting the same plan.
Fund annual health checks for all adults, We want the Government to put in place funding for annual health checks for all adults, to help identify health conditions at an early stage.
Halve fuel duty and remove VAT on fuel prices., Halve the amount of tax that is charged on fuel and also remove VAT from being added.

Make self-employed people eligible for statutory adoption pay, Make statutory adoption pay available to self-employed as well as employed adopters, just as maternity allowance is available for all birth parents (including the self-employed). Stop unfairly disadvantaging this small group, when introducing this pay would benefit children and society as a whole.

Stop the age discrimination for wages. Pay all ages the National Living Wage., Make the national minimum wage equal for all ages, at the National Living Wage rate of £9.50 an hour. Currently the minimum wage for 16 and 17 year olds is £4.81; ages 18, 19, and 20 it is £6.83; ages 21 and 22 it is £9.18. Nothing else is cheaper for younger people. This is not fair.

Fund councils to provide more accessible and secure cycle lanes, The Government should fund local authorities to improve the accessibility and security of cycle lanes, as we have seen an increase in traffic-related incidents involving cyclists in recent years. Investing in infrastructure related to cycle paths could help us with the issue we are facing.
Condemn the US for overturning legal rights to abortion, We want the UK Government to show that they support basic human rights and that women have the right to their own bodies.

Treat Maternity Allowance the same as SMP when claiming other benefits, I am campaigning for mothers that claim Maternity Allowance to have this treated in the same way as SMP when they are claiming other benefits, including the same UC taper rate of 55 pence (SMP) rather than £1 (MA) and for Maternity Allowance not to be affected by the benefit cap.

Make all dog walking and pet sitting (all animals) in other's property regulated, Anybody paid to look after other people's animals, need to be licensed and regulated. 
With Pet first aid and relevant insurance as a minimum. 
It should be compulsory for anybody advertising to display their details and share with customer at booking. 
A full monitored complaint procedure.

Launch a full Public Inquiry into child sexual exploitation (CSE) in Oldham, In July 2022 Oldham councillors put forward a motion calling for a public inquiry into child sexual exploitation in Oldham. We are now calling for intervention and for a Public Inquiry to be launched into CSE in the area.

xray before treatment.
Make scoliosis a known disability., Allow scoliosis patients to have an xray to assess curves, when i asked my gp i was refused.

Make scoliosis a known disability.

Scrap the sugar tax and plans to stop multibuy offers on 'unhealthy' foods, The public should be able to eat and drink what they want, without Government intervention. Some people can also be allergic to sweeteners, making products with sugar substitutes unsuitable. We want the sugar tax, and plans to stop multibuy offers on 'unhealthy' foods, to be dropped.

Ban the sale of over the counter medicines which contain codeine, Make it so that any medicines containing codeine cannot be sold over the counter, and are only available on a prescription basis in the UK.

Grant free prescriptions to people receiving statutory sick pay (SSP), Last year, I almost lost my life due to severe peritonitis infection caused by a burst appendix. This required emergency open surgery followed by an extremely rough 6-week recovery. I received £96 per week. This had to cover taxis to wound clinics and prescriptions. It is not feasible.

Make Plan 2 Student Loans fair by capping the interest rate at 1.5%., Due to the radical interest rates applied, the interest accrued is drastically outpacing repayments leading to loans becoming a life-long tax. As the loan grows, graduates will continue to pay a basic tax rate (>£27,288) of 29% and a higher rate of 49% whilst making little to no impact on the loan.

Amend the Equalities Act 2010 to include menopause as a protected characteristic, To help keep more women in the workplace for longer and to improve their rights I want the Government to add menopause to the Equalities Act 2010 as a protected characteristic, and require employers to make reasonable adjustments for menopausal women.

Require schools to allow all children to play any sport they offer, The Government should require schools to allow children of either sex to play any sport they offer. This would build on the legacy of the Commonwealth Games and Euro 2022 Championship by encouraging all students, regardless of sex or gender, to have access to the same sport curriculum.

Discontinue CPC training for HGV drivers., Discontinue the HGV driver CPC training as the government is considering letting car drivers drive 7.5t vehicles on a car licence with no CPC.

More HGV drivers may renew/come back to driving again if the CPC was removed and this would solve the driver shortage.

Ban DVLA from sharing data of vehicles’ registered keepers, It’s unthinkable that whilst GDPR laws are in force, a Government agency - DVLA - can legally pass personal data of the registered keepers of vehicles to private companies using ANPR cameras and charging drivers penalties on private car parks. It stirs citizens’ lack of trust and should be ended.

Increase Postgraduate Master's Loans to a minimum of £18,000, Postgraduate study should be accessible to all, regardless of background or financial situation. But the amount of Postgraduate Master's Loans is insufficient for many students, especially working class students, and can be a significant barrier to them continuing onto this level of study.

Ensure PIP applications are considered within a maximum of 12 weeks, We want the Government to guarantee that all applications for Personal Independence Payment (PIP) will be considered and a claim granted or rejected within 12 weeks. Currently many claimants wait well over this to hear about their claim.
Create a regulator for veterinary services, We want the Government to create a regulator for veterinary services, with powers to cap fees, especially where there is limited competition.
UK Government to stop funding Somaliland’s Authoritarian regime., Implement sanctions against the Somaliland Government and officials.

Appoint an Adult Mental Health Ambassador and Adult Mental Health Group, Mental health and the lack of a joined up approach and timely services is a major issue.
 
The Government has appointed a Youth Mental Health Ambassador - so the importance and impact of such a role is already realised. We believe there should also be an Adult Mental Health Ambassador.
Freeze student loan repayments for 12 months, Whilst everyone is feeling financial pressures the government should freeze student loan repayments for 12 months.

End All Government Subsidies for Fossil Fuel Companies, The UK is reported to have given over £13bn in subsidies to fossil fuel companies since the Paris agreement in 2015, including £10bn in tax reliefs for exploration and production. This is the third highest in the world, after India and China. These need to stop, and the money put to better use.

Increase the 15.5mph speed limit for e-bikes to a minimum of 20mph, All electric bikes in the UK are subject to an assisted speed limit of 15.5mph. After this speed the bike can be ridden quicker, but the rider will no longer receive assistance from the motor.

Vote of no confidence of current government and call for a general election now, The people of the UK are suffering with debit rasing energy prices, massive fuel prices, wages are not matching inflation rates, our NHS is being under funded, the current tax system is not fair and helps the super rich and not enough is being done to the eco system of our planet
Nationalise energy companies, The Government should take all energy companies back into public ownership to help address the living crisis, as many working people cannot afford it.

Suspend VAT on pet food and pet care for 12 months, and reduce to 5% thereafter, Suspend VAT on pet foods and basic pet care (eg. vet consultations, vaccinations, flea and worm treatments) for a period of 12 months and subsequently reduce it to 5% permanently.

Require rainwater recovery for new builds and offer grants for older properties, The Government should require that all new builds have underground rainwater recovery systems installed. A grant scheme should also be set up. This could be funded by additional taxes on underperforming water companies, to help homeowners to retrofit on existing properties.
Take action to prevent illegal attempts to enter UK across the Channel, The Government must take further action to stop illegal attempts to enter the UK across the Channel.

Make children under three who are disabled eligible for Blue Badges, Change the Blue Badge scheme to enable children of any age with a disability to qualify for one. The 3 year minimum age should be removed from the criteria. Treat all children equally and don't restrict eligibility for Blue Badges to under 3s.

Stop vets euthanising healthy dogs when options are available to save them., Legislate scanning of all healthy or treatable animals prior to euthanasia. 
Check for rescue back up, match keeper with presenter and exhaust all options available to save them by contacting rescues or breeders who should take accountability for pups they breed.
Gov funding is needed for rescues.

Stop energy companies charging more for pre payment meter users., Prevent energy companies charging more to those on pre payment meters. After all they are being paid up front for the energy instead of in arrears.
Suspend school uniform for 12 months, Require schools to temporarily suspend school uniform requirements until we are through the cost of living crisis

Introduce right to 'Net Metering' for generation of renewable energy, Net Metering would credit the amount of energy exported during times of surplus against import at times when generation is low or not available.

Commission an independent audit into spending on NHS Test and Trace, I want the Government to fully account for public money spent on NHS Test and Trace, a programme that had a £37 billion budget for its first two years, and for which there is little evidence of benefits being delivered.

Recognise Irish passport cards & Gibraltar ID cards at UK Border Force's eGates, Irish passport cards and Gibraltar identity cards are the only two card-format travel documents that the UK continues to accept for entry to the UK by all bearers. Therefore please ensure that UK Border Force's eGates start to recognise these two travel documents at all relevant UK ports of entry.
Reduce energy costs, We wish parliament to reduce energy bills.

Automatically remove parental responsibility from domestic abusers, We want the Government to automatically remove parental responsibility from parents who have been found to have committed domestic abuse. This should apply if someone is convicted of a domestic abuse offence, or where a family court finds that domestic abuse has taken place.

CAROLUS III REX: Petition to Restore Full Latin Titles to the English Coinage., The Royal Mint announced on 29 September designs for the new King's specie. They have been met with concern from coin collectors and Royal historians alike. The use of CHARLES III as opposed to CAROLUS III eviscerates 900 years of Britis numismatic tradition and add pig latin to the national coinage

Extend 30-hour free childcare funding to children from their first birthday., Give all children access to 30 hour free childcare funding from their first birthday with working parents resident in England, automatic access to 30 hours free funding per week during term time or 22 hours per week all year round at the hourly rate.

Close All Abattoirs & Campaign for People to Go Vegan for World Vegan Day, 1.2 billion animals are slaughtered each year in the UK. In addition, almost one billion fish and 4.4 billion shellfish are killed each year in the UK. Requiring abattoirs to close and encouraging everyone to go vegan, even just for one day, may not save them all, but it could at least save some.

Make it a legal requirement for cyclists to use cycle paths where available, Cyclists regularly use a road when a cycle path has been provided, which can cause problems for other road users. These paths have been installed at public expense, and should be used. Failure to use a cycle path when one is available should be made a traffic offence.

Ban smoking and vaping in all public spaces, To encourage people to quit smoking and improve public health. The current ban on smoking in enclosed public spaces has been a huge success. Research in the British Medical Journal estimated there were 1,200 fewer hospital admissions for heart attacks in the year following the ban.

Review the Public Duty Costs Allowance (PDCA) for former Prime Ministers, The outgoing Prime Minister Liz Truss is entitled to £115,000 a year for life - having done 44 days work. Added to this that we now have 6 other prime ministers who can claim this, this should be reviewed immediately during a cost of living crisis.

Increase Universal Credit and legacy benefits by £25 a week, Due to the cost of living crisis people on benefits are struggling to afford everyday essentials. Not everyone on benefits can work and the Government is not providing enough support

That globalists be banned from public office, There is a clear democratic deficit affecting all political parties. The aims of globalisation is to destroy the nation state and achieve global monopolies. Their policies undermine the economies of nations by transferring trade and jobs overseas and sabotaging the labour market with open borders.
Reinstate missing motorbike licenses, During the transfer from paper to plastic driving licenses a lot of people lost their A class category license.

Ban use of fireworks by the public after 11pm, and organised displays after 1am, Ban the use of all fireworks by the public for all celebrations, religious or private, after 11pm, except for publicly organised displays, which should be limited to 1am.

Create an official federated social networking presence for MPs, Federated social networking is starting to become more popular, and is an alternative to centralized social media networks, which most MPs currently use. We believe it makes sense for MPs to have access to a clearly official presence.

Commit to not amending the Equality Act's definition of sex, It has been reported that the Government may amend the Equality Act to "make it clear that sex means biological sex rather than gender." The Government has previously committed to not remove legal protections for trans people, an already marginalised group, but this change would do so.

Veterans Day Bank Holiday the Monday following Remembrance Sunday, Create a new Veterans Day Public Holiday.

Numerous countries around the world have public holidays to celebrate, commemorate and remember their Armed Forces and Veterans.

Refund tuition fees for 2020-2023 university students, We want the Government to refund all tuition fees for all university students studying 2020-2023. COVID moved learning online and now there is strike action affecting universities.

Ban landlords from refusing tenants because they have a pet, A lot of dogs and cats get abandoned by their owners each year. Sometimes a pet owner may have to choose between housing and their pet, if a landlord won't allow pets. We believe it’s unfair for landlords to discriminate against people with pets, and that this should be banned.

Seek to rejoin the European Environment Agency, We want the Government to seek to rejoin the European Environment Agency (EEA), so that up to date UK environmental information is published alongside that of EU nations, in a clear, transparent and responsible way.

Provide free sanitary products in schools, Given the rising costs of living, and following on from Scotland's Period Products Act, Government may consider the free provision of sanitary products in public schools, and the provision of free sanitary products to persons from low-income households.

Audit the Scottish Government., We want a full and detailed audit of the Scottish Governments spending. How much they have received, Where it has came from and where it is being spent. We want the Scottish Government to be held accountable for their wild and irresponsible spending practices.

Introduce 'Grow Your Own' Laws for Legal Medical Cannabis Patients (CBPM), Patients prescribed 'CBPM' by a medical specialist should be allowed to maintain 3-6 flowering plants (with extra considerations for starting new seedlings.)

GYO registration database could be maintained via local council, notifying police of local medical grows, similar to Canadian setup.

Ban unfair ground rent clauses from leasehold agreements, Developers selling new properties can no longer have unfair ground rent clauses in leases (eg where the ground rent can double every 10 years). This needs to be expanded so all leasehold properties built after 2000 cannot have such unfair ground rent clauses.

Stop legal aid to anyone who arrives in the country illegally, Entering the uk without I.d or a passport is illegal so why should anyone who arrives in the country illegally be able to claim asylum using legal aid when it's the taxpayers money when we don't know who they are?
Abolish the Arts Council, Abolish the Arts Council, and do not transfer its responsibilities to other government departments.

Stop animal testing, We would like the Government to ban all animal testing UK, including for the development of cosmetics, household products and medicines. Alternatives need to be actively funded. Many products that are tested on animals end up not being suitable for humans. Animal testing is outmoded and should end.

Require schools to teach child sexual abuse and exploitation prevention, To provide awareness, assistance, referral, or resource information for children and families who are victims of child sexual abuse. I want the Government to make it mandatory in the UK Curriculum to teach the above within all schools.

Fund free prescriptions for people diagnosed with an autoimmune disorder., Autoimmune disorders generally require prescribed medication. Medications to treat these disorders compromise the immune system leaving individuals susceptible to infections, 'Flare up's' are also a common battle, both of which require further medication. This can be costly.

In Solidarity to Afghan girls, UK educational institutes to be closed for 1 day, Taliban banned all education for girls and women in Afghanistan. Education is a fundamental right of every human on all grounds. As fellow humans, we would like the UK to show some support and stand with our hopeless Afghan girls, by announcing a day of Solidarity and closing educational institutes.

Make rape, sexual assault and child sexual offences charges a minimum of life, I want the government to introduce laws that mean that the law is stricter on sexual assaults, rape and child sexual offences, preferably making all rape, sexual assault and paedophilia cases have a minimum 15 year sentence.

All Primary school children should receive free school meals, Currently, only children whose families are on less than £7400 a year, and are in receipt of universal credit, are entitled to free school meals.
 
It has been estimated that it would cost 950 million to provide universal free school meals.
